content: If erase verification is enabled (compile switch FlsEraseVer- ificationEnabled set to TRUE): Before writing a flash block, the function Fls_- MainFunction shall compare the contents of the addressed memory area against the value of an erased flash cell to check that the block has been completely erased. If this check fails, the function Fls_MainFunction shall set the FLS module's job result to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED and raise the runtime error FLS_E_VERIFY_ERASE_FAILED .
